scope: Only linked NAUTILUS public ArcGIS app/map/layer, matching ecology/reef/POSER/Moorea entries and a Caribbean/Florida coordinate check; direct relevant source pages. No new broad search.
portal_license_info: Generic disclaimer, including external copyrighted material; does not provide a blanket asset reuse grant.

relevant_findings.name: Red Sea UAV reef mapping data
relevant_findings.published_file_listing: Dataset_1_UAV_orthomosaics_and_DEMs.zip (6.88 GB); Dataset_2_Snorkel_transect_orthomosaics.zip (31.43 GB); Dataset_3_Habitat_classifications.zip (1.38 GB); Dataset_4_Manual_classifications_for_accuracy_assessment.zip (44.82 KB); README.txt (1.04 KB)
relevant_findings.actual_release_description: TIFF orthomosaics/DEMs and habitat/accuracy shapefiles. No true-3D mesh or original reconstruction photographs listed. ZIP contents not downloaded or independently inventoried.
relevant_findings.license: Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal, verified in dataset JSON-LD
relevant_findings.location: Saudi Arabian Red Sea coast near KAUST
relevant_findings.scale: Real very shallow reefs under 5 m deep; map entry maximum depth 4; no released mesh units verified. Spatial_resolution value 1 in portal lacks explicit unit in inspected record.
relevant_findings.decision: Not an appropriate Caribbean living-reef mesh; do not mistake portal 3D-model category for released mesh.

relevant_findings.name: Scott Reef 25
relevant_findings.release_description: 9831 stereo image pairs, 22 GB; multibeam GSF 6.2 MB; SLAM solution and KML 1.4 MB; raw sensor data 7.0 MB. No ready mesh listed.
relevant_findings.license: Page requests attribution; explicit commercial asset reuse license not found on inspected page
relevant_findings.decision: Real reconstruction-input route, different ecology/region and large image package; no download undertaken.

relevant_findings.name: GoPro9UnderwaterVIO
relevant_findings.release_description: Map states two GoPro9 cameras, calibration and odometry sequences; Video, Calibration data, script. No mesh listed.
relevant_findings.location: Map point 30.0033824423028, -82.996895674668; exact acquisition scene not independently verified.
relevant_findings.decision: No usable reef asset verified. Do not equate map point or video metadata with a Caribbean coral survey.

other_results: Remaining relevant records concern Australia/Tasmania stereo imagery, deep-sea or polar surveys, benthic classification imagery, species annotations, Mediterranean monitoring, tabular fauna data, or other nonmatching materials. None was a verified Caribbean living-reef mesh.
poser_moorea_result: No POSER or Moorea asset record returned by the bounded name/description queries.
conclusion: No verified suitable true-3D Caribbean reef asset acquired from this bounded source chain. This does not prove every global reef asset absent or that data acquisition is the only visual-improvement route.
